 What is AO3 and is it back online now? Here's if your works, bookmarks and drafts safe and do you need to change the password
 SECTIONS What is AO3 and is it back online now? Here's if your works, bookmarks and drafts safe and do you need to change the password By Gandharv Walia , Global Desk Last Updated: Nov 16, 2026, 03:25:00 AM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Archive of Our Own a popular fanfiction site has come back online after being offline for 17 days due to a security issue. The site has returned but with some restrictions in place. The Organization for Transformative Works which runs AO3 has confirmed it. Some features are still currently not available. Users can now view their works, bookmarks and kudos.
 TIL Creatives Archive of Our Own a popular fanfiction site has come back online after being offline for 17 days due to a security issue. Representative image Archive of Our Own ( AO3 ) has returned after being offline for 17 days after a security issue. The Organisation for Transformative Works ( OTW ) confirmed early on November 15 that the site has returned. User icons, importing works from other sites and downloading non HTML files are currently not available. The organization have confirmed that users’ works, bookmarks and kudos are safe. They have advised users to change their passwords and save their drafts as normal deletion rules will come back into place.
 What is AO3 and is it back online now?
AO3 has returned after being offline for 17 days. The site returned online on November 15 at around 3am ET after it went offline on October 29 due to a security issue. The OTW status page announced, "AO3 is now up!" Please try refreshing your browser if you’re still seeing the offline message, The OTW status page said.
 Why did AO3 go offline on October 29?
AO3 initially went offline for some maintenance. They confirmed on October 30 that they had found a security issue. They estimated the site may be offline for a minimum of 2 weeks and possibly 4 weeks. Users got a ‘Bad Gateway’ message while trying to access the website. The OTW has teamed up with a security company to look into the issue and assess the security of the website.
 Live Events
 What features are not available on AO3?
Some features of the website are currently not available.
 User icons and collection icons – Icons are not visible on the site.
 Importing works from other sites – Users cannot currently import works from other sites.
 Downloading – Users can only download works in HTML.
 The organization has confirmed these will be available later but have not said when. AO3 has put measures in place to manage the traffic. Some users may find themselves in a Cloudflare waitroom or see a temporary ‘Bad Gateway’.
 Are your works, bookmarks and drafts safe?
The OTW have confirmed users’ works, bookmarks and kudos are safe. They have also said no drafts were deleted.
They have temporarily stopped automatically deleting old drafts. Usually any drafts that have not been published after 30 days will be automatically deleted.
This will be in place till November 29. The organization have said the dates shown on your current drafts may not be accurate. Users have been advised to save copies of their drafts or publish them.
 Do you need to change the password?
All users of the website need to change their passwords. The OTW has said there is no reason to believe the user database has been compromised but they cannot be 100% sure.
